title: Parh Nad-e-Ali Zainab Akhay
body:
Parh Nad-e-Ali Zainab Akhay Meri Kar Baba Imdaday
May Talleyan Maldi Reh Gaiyan Haye Bolda Nai Sajjaday
Ais Wastay Kammar Jhuka Turda
Mera Istagbal Nai Seh Sakeya
Jis Velay Di Chadar Utri
Ay Kaddam Kaddam Tey Qatal Hoya,
Teri Nasal Da Varis Gir Gaya Hay
Enu Aakay Hoosh Keraday
Sun Hokay Baba Ujri De
Khaiber Nu Chaana Sokha ye
Zainab Day Naal Sharabi Tey
Darbar Che Jaana Okha Hay
Har Zulm Nu Jera Seh Gaya Hay
Bus Ooh Mazloom Sajjaday
Nai Laash Hussain Tey Ron Ditta
May Phir Vi Baba Chup Raiyan
Kai Baar Bachaya Abid Nu
Khud Aap May Sehndi Dukh Raiyan
Baazar Abur May Ker Aiyan
Darbar Abur Keraday
Meton Puch Baba Sir Ghazi Da
Kioun Naizay Tey Nai Aunda Hay
Sir Nanga Vekh Kay Zainab Da
Abbas Da Sir Gir Ja'anda Hay
Bardash Na Ghazi Ker Sakeya
Khulay Vaal Ay Dhee Zahra Day
Kerbal Ton Lay Kay Shaam Taiyn
Jeri Rondi Rai Din Raat Hay
Keeta Hamla Phir Yazeediyan Nay
Nai Kabbar Day Vich Vi Chainay
Tu Jag Da Varas Hay Maula
Zainab Da Haram Bacha Day
Teray Puttar Abbas Di Chup Baba
Menu Shaam Day Vich Lay Ay Hay
Fareyad Hassan Ay Kerdi Si
Sir Nangay Zahra Jai Hay
Aik Chadar Najaf Ton Lay Aa Tu
Ujri Day Sir Tey Paa Day
